learning_outcomes.text: Interpret the relationships between the mechanical and physical properties of polymers.
Gain knowledge about the viscoelastic-dynamic properties of polymers and the effects of process parameters on processing.
Acquire knowledge to distinguish between different polymer processing techniques.
Solve problems related to various properties and processing of polymers independently or by working in a team.
Ability to work individually and in groups, and to communicate in writing and orally.

syllabus_topics: Physical and Viscoelastic Properties in Polymer Processing
First and Second Order Transitions in Polymeric Materials
Effects of Structure and Some Additives on Glass Transition Temperature
Introduction to the Use of Polymers as Membranes
